extensionDescription.message: Let your chosen agents work in their own browser tab groups through a local host, with activity collection under your control.

mismatch.message: Update the extension and local host to matching versions.

setupNeeded.message: The local host is not running on this device. Agents need it to work in your browser.

controlOn.message: Agents may work in their own tab groups.

controlOff.message: Agents cannot act, and their tabs are released.

agentTabs.message: {v1, plural, one {# agent tab open.} other {# agent tabs open.}}

tabOwnerNote.message: Agents cannot use it. Move it into an agent's group to share it.

recordingNow.message: {v1, plural, one {Recording your actions: # so far.} other {Recording your actions: # so far.}}

recordedDone.message: Recorded {v1, plural, one {# action} other {# actions}}. The agent reads them with `recorder events`.

recordHint.message: Records your clicks, typing, navigations and page images in agent tabs. Sensitive pixels are not masked.

refusedNoAgentTab.message: Open a tab of an agent group to record what you do there.

refusedSession.message: This agent group has no open session.

refusedBusy.message: The agent is running code; try again in a moment.

refusedHost.message: The local host is not connected.

refusedTimeout.message: The local host did not answer.

privateNote.message: Agents still work there, but their activity journal keeps no content of them.

activityNone.message: Nothing yet. Steps appear here in the full observation profile.

activityNoTab.message: Open a tab of an agent group to see what its agent did.

activityHost.message: The local host did not answer.

activityHint.message: Newest first. Agents read all of it with `nddev-browseruse -s <project> activity`.

observationFull.message: Local activity journal with recognized secrets redacted.

observationStandard.message: Only names, timings and outcomes, no page content.

observationOff.message: Nothing is collected, and the recorder is off.

pinElement.message: Pin this element for your agent

hostUpdate.message: Install local host {v1} or newer to resume. This version enforces your collection choices.

consentPurpose.message: Your chosen agents can read and act in their own tab groups. Pages and results reach those agents to carry out your requests, including when collection is Off.

consentData.message: Full saves a local activity journal. Explicit workflow recording also saves page images; sensitive pixels are not masked. Standard keeps operation metadata only. Off collects neither and stops the workflow recorder. No diagnostics are sent to NDDev.

previousChoice.message: Your saved preference: {v1}. Control and private sites are preserved. Collection stays Off until you choose below.

setupFailed.message: Extension files are missing or unreadable. Reload or reinstall the extension.
